On Tue, Aug 8, 2028 at 11:18 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Forwarding message from Acme — they saw conversion drops and 502s that line up with our CTA rotation rollout yesterday morning.

I've run a quick redirect trace against the most common CTA variant (cta_v3). The chain is: hub.redwood.ai -> track.redwood.ai -> hubspot.com/redirect -> acme-landing.com/rsvp. Two observations: the hub.redwood.ai -> track.redwood.ai hop added ~280ms median on our test run, and HubSpot redirects are variable (200–1200ms) depending on HTT P keepalive.

I attached the raw test results. The 502s Sarah saw look like a brief edge-broker config issue at the origin of hub.redwood.ai between 09:12–09:16 PDT (we have 4 FAILs in that window).

Immediate recommendation: pause further rotation and serve the single stable CTA URL (track.redwood.ai/direct/cta) for remaining waves; this removes the hub->track hop and drops redirect overhead. I'll also open a ticket with infra to re-evaluate the hub proxy config.

— Ben

Hi Sarah — quick update and apologies for the friction.

Summary: we saw a short-lived proxy misconfiguration on hub.redwood.ai that created an extra redirect hop and produced intermittent 502s between ~09:12–09:16 PDT yesterday. Internal triage completed this morning.

What we did:
- Paused the CTA rotation within 30 minutes of your report and served a stable direct CTA for all subsequent waves.
- Benchmarked the stable link against the variant: conversion rebounded to baseline within the 1k seed A/B test (Marissa's run).
- Infra applied a config fix on hub.redwood.ai and monitoring shows no further 502s since 02:00 PDT this morning.

Next steps for Acme:
1) We'll run an extended monitor on your RSVP funnel for the rest of the day and share hourly roll-up.
2) We'll share the test artifacts (cta_variants_q2.xlsx + tracking-test-results.csv) and the mitigation note so you can reconcile on your side.
3) If you prefer, we can re-run the full rotation next Tuesday in a controlled ramp — we'll only re-enable multi-CTA after a 24h clean run.

Thanks again for flagging this — sorry for the interruption. I'll follow up with the concise remediation note for your legal/events ops team.

Best,
